newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes Aviation November traffic up.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes Aviation November traffic up.

text.p: Great Lakes Aviation Ltd said Monday its passenger load factor in November reached 42.1 percent, up from 40.6 percent in November of 1995.
The carrier added that revenue passenger miles topped 23.6 million, up from 21.0 million a year ago. The number of available seat miles in November rose to 56.1 million from 51.8 million.
In the 11 months through November, load factor rose to 44.2 percent from 44.1 percent, the company said.
There were 623.3 million available seat miles and 275.3 million revenue passenger miles in the period, compared with 517.8 million available seat miles and 228.4 million revenue passenger miles.
Great Lakes operates three regional airlines: United Express in the upper Midwest; Midway Connection on the East Coast and Great Lakes Airlines in certain Southwest markets.
The company's stock closed unchanged at 2-3/4.
